buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Registered Office in Kerala: The OEM/Seller must have a registered office in Kerala. A copy of the bidder's GST Registration Certificate showing the Kerala address shall be submitted. 2. ISO Certification: The company shall possess a valid ISO certification and attach documentary proof. 3. Relevant Experience: The bidder shall have prior experience in the supply and installation of similar items as specified in the bid. Copies of relevant work orders shall be submitted as proof. 4. Service Centre: A functional service centre shall be available in the consignee's district. Documentary proof of the service c entre address shall be provided. 5. GeM Listing and Financial Turnover: The quoted product shall be listed on the GeM portal. The bidder shall have an average annual financial tu rnover of at least ₹2 crore during the last three financial years. Documentary evidence shall be submitted. 6. Clean Incident History: The bidder shall have a clean business record with no adverse or negative reputation. Supporting docume nts/self-declaration shall be furnished

7. Seller Rating: The bidder's overall GeM rating shall not be less than 4.5. 8. Warranty Verification: Warranty details shall be verifiable on the OEM's official website. The bidder shall provide the product's se rial number and part number for warranty verification. 9. Service Support: The bidder shall provide 24×7 service support throughout the warranty period. 10. Product Sample: The bidder/OEM shall provide a product sample for evaluation prior to the technical assessment, if require d by the Purchase Committee. 11. OEM Authorization: A Bid-Specific Manufacturer's Authorization Form (MAF) from the OEM shall be submitted as specified in th e bid document. 12. OEM ISO Certification: Both the bidder and the OEM shall possess valid ISO certification, and documentary proof shall be submitte d. 13. GeM Experience: The bidder shall have a minimum of Six years' experience on the GeM portal and shall provide supporting documentary evidence. .
